description: Rotating the root control 90 degrees about Z swings every branch around the origin. A quarter turn about Z sends (x, y) to (-y, x): mag (0,-2) goes to (2,0), magTip (0,-4) to (4,0), trigger (1,0) to (0,1), grip (0,-1,2) to (1,0,2) and gripEnd (0,-2,2) to (2,0,2). The handle is on the Z axis and stays put
